verdict.rationale: ELSTER has a sanctioned third-party software channel: any tax software that supports ELSTER can transmit through its rail (elster-docs-2, elster-supp-2). The probe names ERiC as the developer-artifact channel whose host previously served download bundles, which hints at an official SDK. However, no first-party doc in the pack describes an SDK, its languages, APIs or how to obtain it. The single timed-out GET on the artifact host is an access observation, not proof the SDK is gone. Missing for 10: first-party SDK documentation (ERiC scope, languages, API reference), a confirmed working download/access path, and independent hands-on corroboration of building against it.
